details:
AGRO ROTA

AGRO ROTA is a web application designed to support farmers in Panama through smart and sustainable agriculture. It combines soil measurements collected through sensors connected to an ESP32, or entered manually, with NASA satellite and climate data to help farmers understand their land and make better crop rotation decisions.

The platform includes several sections: farm management, NASA data, crop registration, crop rotation planning, offline access, and accessibility settings. Its main benefits are helping farmers monitor soil conditions, plan crop rotations, improve soil conservation, and make more informed agricultural decisions.

The expected impact is to promote sustainable farming, encourage responsible water use, protect soil health, and help agricultural communities adapt to changing environmental conditions.

The project was developed using Lovable as the web development platform. Its interface is designed as a web application, with an ESP32 as the planned hardware for collecting sensor measurements and NASA data as an important source of environmental information.

AGRO ROTA is creative because it brings satellite information, local soil measurements, and crop rotation planning together in one accessible platform. Our team considered factors such as limited internet connectivity in rural areas, ease of use for farmers of different ages, soil conditions, water availability, and the needs of local crops.

Our goal is to make agricultural technology more accessible and useful for farmers in Panama.
